title: Stale fct_daily_revenue from a failing Airflow job
issue_description: The 'Total Revenue by Region' dashboard shows no data for the last two days (2024-01-29 and 2024-01-30), even though the business was clearly still taking orders on those days.
ground_truth_root_cause: The build_fct_daily_revenue job has been failing for the last 2 days (connection timeouts to the warehouse) and has not successfully refreshed fct_daily_revenue since 2024-01-28T15:15:07Z. The upstream stg_orders_cleaned table is fully up to date; fct_daily_revenue is simply stale because the job that populates it stopped succeeding.

ground_truth_location.detail: Job's last_run_status is 'failed' and last_run_at is 2 days stale; no rows exist in fct_daily_revenue for the last 2 days of the window.
